title: Signal: SQLite statement built from an interpolated string in swift — review required
scope: Single-line match on sqlite3_exec in swift.
limitations: Lexical: matches sqlite3_exec calls only; statements built in a helper are out of scope.

examples.line: sqlite3_exec(db, "SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = '\(name)'", nil, nil, nil)
